anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature jumps from ~348 °C to 360.8 then 381.4 °C in two minutes, far above the prior ~0.2 °C/min drift
Differential pressure steps from ~2.0 to 5.7/5.0 mbar coincident with the T701 excursion
System pressure dips to 293.9 mbar at the same event
Distillate flow remains ~0 despite rising reboiler duty; column temperatures above the reboiler stopped rising

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler level/heater duty setpoint and whether T701 excursion tracks a real boil-up (vapor reaching T702-T704) or a thermocouple/dry-out artifact; a distillate composition sample.
